SELECT count(*) FROM market_ops.export_jobs WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING')

WITH candidate AS ( SELECT export_id FROM market_ops.export_jobs WHERE status = 'QUEUED' AND cancel_requested = false ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE market_ops.export_jobs job SET status = 'RUNNING', state_revision = state_revision + 1, lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, started_at = coalesce(started_at, now()) FROM candidate WHERE job.export_id = candidate.export_id RETURNING job.export_id, job.idempotency_key, job.request_sha256, job.request_payload::text AS request_payload, job.source_revision, job.query_fingerprint, job.format, job.status, job.state_revision, job.cancel_requested, job.lease_owner, job.lease_expires_at, job.created_at, job.started_at, job.completed_at, job.expires_at, job.row_count, job.detail_row_count, job.details_truncated, job.content_key, job.content_type, job.content_length, job.content_sha256, job.failure_code
mapper.update: UPDATE market_ops.export_jobs SET cancel_requested = true, status = 'CANCELLED', state_revision = state_revision + 1, completed_at = coalesce(completed_at, now()), lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null, content_key = CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN null ELSE content_key END, content_type = CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN null ELSE content_type END, content_length = CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN null ELSE content_length END, content_sha256 = CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN null ELSE content_sha256 END WHERE export_id = #{id} AND status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')

UPDATE market_ops.export_jobs SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', state_revision = state_revision + 1, completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null, row_count = #{rowCount}, detail_row_count = #{detailRowCount}, details_truncated = #{detailsTruncated}, content_key = #{contentKey}, content_type = #{contentType}, content_length = #{contentLength}, content_sha256 = #{contentSha256} WHERE export_id = #{exportId} AND state_revision = #{revision} AND status = 'RUNNING' AND cancel_requested = false

UPDATE market_ops.export_jobs SET status = 'FAILED', state_revision = state_revision + 1, completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null, failure_code = #{code}, failure_summary = left(#{summary}, 512) WHERE export_id = #{exportId} AND state_revision = #{revision} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE market_ops.export_jobs SET status = 'CANCELLED', state_revision = state_revision + 1, completed_at = #{completedAt}, lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null WHERE export_id = #{exportId} AND state_revision = #{revision} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE market_ops.export_jobs SET status = CASE WHEN cancel_requested THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'QUEUED' END, state_revision = state_revision + 1, completed_at = CASE WHEN cancel_requested THEN coalesce(completed_at, #{now}) ELSE completed_at END, lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < #{now}
